name: Daidouji Hayato
source:
St. Ao Academy 1st year high school student. C class.

A shy and short boy.
He doesn't like unfamiliar surroundings and will often skip school, but he will sometimes impulsively show up.
His family is famous for flower arranging, and he also studies it.
